comparison.objective: Dry all exposed and hidden regions of long articulated hair with a handheld dryer, then switch off, park, and release it while the head remains fixed.
comparison.physical_skill: Dryer pickup and switch operation, airflow aiming, thermal control, and manipulation of flexible hair bundles to expose occluded layers.
comparison.success_condition: Every one of 960 patches retains at most 10% water; temperature stays at or below 50°C; hair remains attached, head motion stays within 2 mm/1°, and the powered-off parked dryer and clear hands remain stable for 1 s. A full-task allowance is still unspecified.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests close-clearance insertion, ball-lock retention, load-bearing lift, three-pad seating, unloading, and pin extraction. Hair exposure and geometry-dependent drying are materially different abilities; generic grasping and parking do not establish overlap.
